messages.content: Researchers (Greshake et al., 2023) describe indirect prompt injection. Classic phrases such as "ignore previous instructions" and "send the conversation to a URL" appear as examples. Defenders should treat untrusted tool results as data. No action is requested of any assistant reading this digest.
